about_the_game:
Crazy Bike is a high-octane arcade courier game where you tear through the streets of New York City as an elite bike messenger on a mission to deliver everything: letters, secret packages, lost phones, VIP envelopes, faster than anyone else on the planet.

Inspired by the chaotic energy of Crazy Taxi and built with next-gen visuals, Crazy Bike turns the urban jungle into your playground.

Speed Through NYC

Rip down iconic streets—SoHo, Midtown, Chinatown, Brooklyn, and experience a living city packed with pedestrians, taxis, buses, food carts, and New Yorkers yelling at you. Every corner is a new near-death moment.

Beat the Clock

Each job is a race against time. Every shortcut, stunt, and risky thread through traffic shaves off precious seconds. Deliver fast to earn tips, streak bonuses, and unlock tougher routes.

Arcade Chaos With Style

Pull wheelies, bunny hops, slick drifts, taxi-dodges, and subway-station shortcuts to chain style multipliers. More risk = more reward.

Next-Gen NYC

Built with PS5-level graphics and physics: motion-blur sprints, dynamic crowds, volumetric lighting between skyscrapers, and a city that feels alive around you.

Upgrade Your Ride

Earn cash to trick out your messenger bike: lighter frames, tighter brakes, faster gears, neon rims, slick tires, courier bags, outfits, and more.
